flags.message: Frozen band is 'state' (sal-v4), but the petitioner is a federal warden represented by the Solicitor General, with no state party in the caption. The caption-class rule would place this as 'federal'. I anchored on the federal floor (~70% pooled reached) instead of state (~23.5%).
No record/documents/ were provisioned (no petition/QP/BIO text). Also, CourtListener opinion 10729625 (Daley v. Choate, 10th Cir. 24-1191) serves the text of an unrelated district-court order.
